CreateTopic.description_en: A topic is the smallest unit for subscription and publishing in DataHub. You can use a topic to represent a type or category of streaming data
CreateTopic.description_zh: Topic是 DataHub 订阅和发布的最小单位，用户可以用Topic来表示一类或者一种流数据

DeleteProject.description_en: Deletes a project. Before deleting a project, you must delete all resources under the project, including topics, synchronization tasks, and subscription tasks
DeleteProject.description_zh: 删除project，删除前需要删除project下的所有资源(Topic、同步任务、订阅任务)

DeleteTopic.description_en: Deletes a topic resource. Before deleting a topic resource, you must delete all subscriptions and sync tasks under the topic
DeleteTopic.description_zh: 删除topic资源，删除topic资源前需要删除对应topic下的所有订阅和同步任务

GetConnector.description_en: Queries the information about a synchronization task

GetRecords.description_en: Reads data from a specified topic. This operation is primarily used for debugging. For high-volume data reading, refer to the SDK documentation
GetRecords.description_zh: 读取指定topic的数据，主要是调试使用，大流量的读取请参考官方文档的SDK介绍

ListConnectors.description_en: Retrieves a list of synchronization tasks

ListGroups.description_en: Retrieves a list of consumer groups

PutRecords.description_en: Writes data to a specified topic. This operation is primarily used for debugging. For high-volume data writes, refer to the SDK documentation
PutRecords.description_zh: 向指定的topic写入数据，主要是调试使用，大流量的写入请参考官方文档的SDK介绍

UpdateProject.description_en: Updates the description of a project

UpdateTopic.description_en: Updates the description of a topic
